Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.commands

Class StateEndCommand

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command
frc.lib.NinjasLib.commands.StateEndCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable
public class StateEndCommand extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command
Runs a sequence of commands one after another, like WPILib's SequentialCommandGroup, but with one key difference: once finished, isFinished() keeps returning true instead of the finished status being tied to the current command index. This makes it suitable for use as a StateMachineBase state-end condition (see StateMachineBase.addStateEnd), where the state machine polls isFinished() once per loop and needs a stable answer rather than one that could flap. Commands passed in here should only represent waiting for an event (e.g. waitUntil/waitTime), not actual robot logic.

      public final boolean isFinished()
      Overrides:
      isFinished in class edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command
      Returns:
